# Alsei & Diive: Optimize

**A&D Optimize mainly focuses on making the game we all love work much better with bunch of bug fixes and enhancing performance.**

By adding well known optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium etc. Bug fixer mods like Modern Fix, Block Entity Model Features etc. This mod is designed to fully optimize Minecraft without even you noticing any visual changes. It is just Minecraft but way more times faster.
